description: Billions Spent, Crisis Unchanged Mike Fong identified reducing homelessness as a key priority, yet despite billions in statewide investments, including tens of billions over recent years, California's homelessness crisis persists with immeasurable progress. Rates have remained stubbornly high or shown negligible declines.
